In March 2026, China's Consumer Price Index (CPI) increased by 1.0% year on year. Of this total, food prices went up by 2.6 percent and non-food prices went up by 0.6 percent.

In March, China's CPI decreased by 0.7% month on month. Of this total, food prices declined by 1.6 percent and non-food prices declined by 0.5 percent.

From January to March 2026, on average, the national CPI was 0.4 percent higher than the same period of the previous year.
